```{r}
source("2) BiodivAF.R")
source("3) BiodivAF-check.R")
library(patchwork)   # for arranging multiple ggplots
library(gridExtra)   # for empty placeholder text

# Define number of repeats
n_repeats <- 3
# Define threshold for outlier models
rmse_threshold <- 7.5

# --- Preallocate --- 
mods_list <- list(
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age"),
  c("Climate", "Soil_type", "Age"),
  c("Age"),
  c("Tree_SR", "Shrub_layer", "Age"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Age"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Age"),
  c("Tree_SR", "Shrub_layer", "Age"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Tree_SR", "Shrub_layer", "Age"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"),
  c("forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age", "Alley.width"))
interactions_list <- list(
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  character(0),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  character(0),
  character(0),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  character(0),
  c("Age:forestshrub_frac", "Age:Tree_SR"),
  character(0))
SA_SP.add_list <- c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, 
                    TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)

model_eval <- data.frame(
  model_nr = integer(),
  formula = character(),
  correct_in_CI = numeric(),
  mean_CI_width = numeric(),
  outlier_prev = numeric(),
  slope = numeric(),
  slope_p = numeric(),
  intercept_p = numeric(),
  rmse_1to1 = numeric(),
  pll = numeric(),
  ic = numeric(),
  n_moderators_frac = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
best_coef <- 1000
plots_list <- list()

# SA_SP.add_list <- SA_SP.add_list[1:2]  # Limit to ... models

# --------------------------------
# --- Loop over moderator sets ---
# --------------------------------
for (p in 1:length(SA_SP.add_list)){
  optie <- "Dependant validation set"
  mods <- mods_list[[p]]
  interactions <- interactions_list[[p]]
  SA.add <- SA_SP.add_list[p]
  SP.add <- SA_SP.add_list[p]
  
  n_moderators_frac <- 0 # Preallocate
  
  # ------------------------------------
  # --- Run model in n_repeats times ---
  # ------------------------------------
  all_preds_list <- lapply(1:n_repeats, function(rep_id) {
  
    # --- Run model building ---
    source("1) Model_updates.R") 
    
    # ----------------------------------
    # --- # of moderators and models ---
    # ----------------------------------
    model_files <- list.files("model_outputs", pattern = "^model_.*\\.rds$", full.names = FALSE)
    
    if (SA.add) {
      n_moderators_frac <<- n_moderators_frac + (length(mods) + 1)*length(model_files)/n_repeats # <<- to update outside function
    } else {
      n_moderators_frac <<- n_moderators_frac + length(mods)*length(model_files)/n_repeats # <<- to update outside function
    }
    
    # -----------------------
    # --- Run predictions ---
    # -----------------------
    preds <- tryCatch({
      purrr::map_dfr(model_files, ~predict_from_saved_rma_model(.x, validation)) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)),
             rep_id = rep_id)  # track repeat
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Prediction failed for run ", p, " & repeat ", rep_id, ": ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  # ------------------------------------
  # --- Combine all repeats - output ---
  # ------------------------------------
  all_preds <- bind_rows(all_preds_list)
  
  if (is.null(all_preds) || !"ROM_Pred" %in% names(all_preds) || nrow(all_preds) == 0) {
    formula_str <- "No models available"
    
    # --- Placeholder plot if failed ---
    p1 <- ggplot() + 
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
               label = paste("Model", p, "failed\n", formula_str, "SA/SP.add = ", SA.add),
               size = 3, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5) +
      theme_void()
    
    # Also store NA in evaluation
    model_eval <- rbind(
      model_eval,
      data.frame(
        formula = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, " || SA/SP.add = ", SA.add),
        model_nr = p,
        correct_in_CI = NA,
        mean_CI_width = NA,
        outlier_prev = NA,
        slope = NA,
        slope_p = NA,
        intercept_p = NA,
        rmse_1to1 = NA,
        pll = NA,
        ic = NA,
        n_moderators_frac = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    
  } else {
    model_files <- list.files("model_outputs", pattern = "^model_.*\\.rds$", full.names = FALSE)
    # Extract model formula
    first_model_path <- file.path("model_outputs", model_files[1])
    model <- readRDS(first_model_path)
    formula_str <- paste(deparse(model$mod_formula), collapse = "")
    
    # --- Evaluate ---
    outliers <- all_preds %>% mutate(is_outlier = abs(ROM_Pred) > 5)
    outlier_prevalence <- nrow(filter(outliers, is_outlier)) / nrow(all_preds)
    
    results <- evaluate_model(all_preds)
    
    model_eval <- rbind(
      model_eval,
      data.frame(
        model_nr = p,
        formula = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, " || SA/SP.add = ", SA.add),
        correct_in_CI = results$correct_in_CI,
        mean_CI_width = results$mean_CI_width,
        outlier_prev = outlier_prevalence,
        slope = results$slope,
        slope_p = results$slope_p,
        intercept_p = results$intercept_p,
        rmse_1to1 = results$rmse_1to1,
        pll = results$pll,
        ic = results$ic,
        n_moderators_frac = n_moderators_frac,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    
    # --- Plot ---
    p1 <- ggplot(all_preds, aes(x = yi, y = ROM_Pred)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "black", linewidth = 1.25) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 1.5) +
      geom_abline(intercept = results$intercept, slope = results$slope,
              color = "red", linewidth = 1.5) +
      labs(
        x = "Raw data (ROM)",
        y = "Metafor Prediction (ROM)",
        title = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, "SA/SP.add = ", SA.add)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5)) +
      xlim(-5, 5) + ylim(-5, 5) 
    
    p_tmp <- ggplot(all_preds, aes(x = yi, y = ROM_Pred)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "black", linewidth = 1.25) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 1.5) +
      geom_abline(intercept = results$intercept, slope = results$slope,
              color = "red", linewidth = 1.5) +
      labs(
        x = "Raw data (ROM)",
        y = "Metafor Prediction (ROM)",
        title = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, " || SA/SP.add = ", SA.add)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5))

    print(p1)
    
    if (!is.na(results$slope) && abs(1-results$slope) < best_coef){
      p_best_model <- p1
      p_best_model_outliers <- p_tmp
      best_coef <- abs(1-results$slope)
    }
    
    # --- Adjust plots for grid visualization ---
    p1 <-ggplot(all_preds, aes(x = yi, y = ROM_Pred)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_abline(intercept = results$intercept, slope = results$slope,
              color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
      labs(title = paste("Model", p)) +
      xlim(-5, 5) + ylim(-5, 5) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.title = element_blank(), 
            axis.text = element_blank(), 
            axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
            plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2), # tighter margins 
            plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5)) + 
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1) # ensures square plots 
    
  }
  
  plots_list[[p]] <- p1
}

# --- Arrange panels (4x6 per page, A4) ---
plots_per_page <- 24
num_pages <- ceiling(length(plots_list) / plots_per_page)

for (page in 1:num_pages) {
  start_idx <- (page - 1) * plots_per_page + 1
  end_idx <- min(page * plots_per_page, length(plots_list))
  
  grid <- wrap_plots(plots_list[start_idx:end_idx], ncol = 4, nrow = 6, byrow = TRUE) &
    theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))  # remove global extra margins
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0("model_validation_page_", page, ".png"),
         plot = grid, width = 29.7, height = 42, units = "cm"  )
}

# Ensure no rownames creep in
rownames(model_eval) <- NULL 

# Inspect comparison table
model_eval <- model_eval %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize metrics (z-scores)
    z_rmse              = scale(rmse_1to1),             # smaller = better !!! differences in datasets
    z_pll               = scale(-pll),                  # bigger = better !!! differences in datasets
    z_ic                = scale(ic),                    # smaller = better !!! differences in datasets
    z_outlier           = scale(outlier_prev),          # smaller = better !!! differences in datasets + shouldn't they be removed?
    z_slope             = scale(abs(1 - slope)),        # smaller = better
    z_slope_p           = scale(-slope_p),              # bigger = better
    z_intercept_p       = scale(-intercept_p),          # bigger = better # What relevance?
    z_correct           = scale(-correct_in_CI),        # bigger = better
    z_mean_CI_width     = scale(mean_CI_width),         # smaller = better # Combination of significance level and cI width needed
    z_n_moderators_frac = scale(n_moderators_frac),     # bigger = better

    # Total score = sum of standardized metrics
    total_score = z_rmse + z_pll + z_correct + z_mean_CI_width + z_slope_p + z_n_moderators_frac) %>%
  arrange(total_score) %>%
  dplyr::select(formula, model_nr, correct_in_CI, mean_CI_width, outlier_prev, slope, slope_p, intercept_p, rmse_1to1, pll, ic, n_moderators_frac, total_score)

model_eval
write.csv(model_eval, "model_evaluation_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
p_best_model
p_best_model_outliers

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Final run: Make sure a right version is stocked to run BiodivAF-app
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Preallocate things needed and run
model_nr <- model_eval$model_nr[1]
optie <- "Full tool dataset"
mods <- mods_list[[model_nr]]
interactions <- interactions_list[[model_nr]]
SA.add <- SA_SP.add_list[model_nr]
SP.add <- SA_SP.add_list[model_nr]
  
# --- Run model building ---
source("1) Model_updates.R")
```
